note: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands: from 1 August 2025 everyone entering to work needs an entry permit for work, six months and extendable, on the contract under which they'll work. No one is home there but its own. British citizens and the other territories' passports, though of the same nationality, need it too and are named; the territory's own are home.

sources.title: Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, Entry Control Order Permit Application
sources.said: entering South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands for work or visitor purposes will require an Entry Permit.There will be separate permits for work and visitor purposes. ... A work permit is valid for 6 months.
